scope: Fetch/pickup and busy-duplicant scheduler activation evidence for FetchPickupCandidatePatch and BusyDuplicantChoreThrottlePatch; CycleTrim remains conservative and does not enable any patch under FastTrack in this change.

busyDuplicantPickupSensor.behavior: FastTrack returns false from a low-priority prefix, replacing PickupableSensor.Update when PickupOpts is active. CycleTrim also targets PickupableSensor.Update as one part of BusyDuplicantChoreThrottlePatch.

busyDuplicantScheduler.behavior: With PickupOpts active, FastTrack replaces BrainScheduler.RenderEveryTick and routes brain groups through PriorityBrainScheduler.UpdateBrainGroup, which consumes priorityBrains according to ChorePriorityMode. Delay mode additionally gates Brain.UpdateChores on PickupOpts + FastReachability + ChorePriorityMode=Delay. This is an indirect scheduler/chore-pipeline interaction with CycleTrim's FindNextChore throttle and PrioritizeBrain invalidation hook, not a same-target patch conflict.

observedContract.cycleTrimCurrentPolicy: Keep both CycleTrim patches behind the existing FetchManagerFastUpdate type-presence guard. The direct PickupableSensor conflict and the indirect busy-duplicant scheduler/chore interaction remain pinned evidence for later real-game compatibility work; this contract does not prove that feature-level activation is runtime-safe.
